scope: The Crossley telescope’s observatory dome, drum and attached exterior volumes at Lick Observatory on Mount Hamilton as photographed in August 2019.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The observatory describes the 36-inch reflector and the transfer of the instrument and dome to Mount Hamilton.
The technical manual identifies the Crossley installation and its instrument. The reported 36 inches refers to the reflector.

sectionBasis: Round stucco drum with a segmented pale metal hemisphere, roof-shutter track, and the two mapped projecting annexes extending to the original hillside.
